summary: Weather surface / session UI update: initializes a description buffer via FAILWRONGDESCRIPTION, returns 0 early when UniqueID fails, then dispatches a state with argument 0, builds session config via SessionConfigBuilder, sends the buffer through BufferSendWithLocks, encodes a progress-bar event (type 4, stage 5) seeded with the session-time double dbl_8AFEA0, creates textures via TextureCreationWrapper, and issues a system OS API call on unk_7CE24D. Returns 1 on success.

operations.description: FAILWRONGDESCRIPTION(v2) initializes or validates the description buffer v2.
UniqueID(v2) returns 0 for an invalid identifier; the whole update is blocked.
Return 0 immediately when UniqueID reports the identifier invalid.
ConditionalStateDispatch(0) dispatches the current state with argument 0.
SessionConfigBuilder(v2) builds the session configuration data from the description buffer.
BufferSendWithLocks(dword_7CD25C, v2) sends the prepared buffer to the module manager under locks.
Load the session time double into v1 from dbl_8AFEA0.
ProgressBarEventEncode(4, 5, 0, 0, v1, 1) encodes a progress-bar event (type 4, stage 5) using the session time.
TextureCreationWrapper(dword_7CD25C, v3, 2, -1, -1) creates or updates the texture resources for the weather display.
SystemOSAPICall_0dc0(&unk_7CE24D) issues the OS/system API call against the transition flag global.
Return 1 once the full update sequence has completed.

unresolved: Contents and layout of the description buffer v2 and texture array v3 are unknown.
The meaning of the progress-bar event parameters (type 4, stage 5, flags) is derived only from the call site.
The semantics of unk_7CE24D and how the system OS API call uses it are not explained by the raw source.
